A TARGETED pass chases named gaps and leads; a SYSTEMATIC pass declares its source lanes and window before searching, and is complete only when every lane was executed. A window searched with the budget exhausted is PARTIAL, not researched-and-quiet.

lanes.source_family: Ministry of Energy statements as carried by SPA (spa.gov.sa; moenergy.gov.sa), reached through Saudi outlets republishing them
registry: Ministry of Energy statements (Saudi Press Agency)
lanes.finding: SPA search and index pages returned HTTP 403 to ordinary access in this pass, so whether they are script-rendered could not be observed (iteration 17 saw a script-rendered shell at the same search address). No circumvention was attempted.
lanes.limitation: Nothing was searched or read in this pass: all ten declared queries were refused by the shared search limit (five attempted, none performed), and SPA (HTTP 403) and the ministry site (no response) refused ordinary access once each. The four English year queries for 2022-2025 have still never been run in any pass.

lanes.source_family: Saudi Aramco disclosures: Tadawul announcements; aramco.com news and annual-report incident statements
lanes.finding: All four annual reports (FY2022-FY2025) were read in English. No report mentions the March 2022 YASREF event already in the corpus, or any fire, unplanned shutdown, force majeure or production shut-in in 2022-2025. The other dated incidents named are outside the window (2019, 2021). The FY2025 report's events-after-the-reporting-period note lists only financing and a share repurchase. Aramco annual reports are therefore not an incident source for this window.
lanes.limitation: The Tadawul announcement list refused access (HTTP 403) and was not read; neither declared query ran (shared search limit); the Arabic annual reports were not read (English editions only). Aramco's 2026 interim reports and results releases were deliberately not opened: they are outside the declared 2022-2025 annual-report universe and would carry current operating information during the active campaign.

lanes.source_family: GASTAT and JODI production releases (production effects explicitly attributed to a disruption)
lanes.finding: GASTAT does not attribute production changes to a disruption in the releases read. The monthly IPI release is a short bulletin of index movements: it says the index moved 'affected by the decline in mining and quarrying activity' and names the manufacturing sub-activities that moved, but gives no cause for the mining or refining movement (no incident, attack, outage or policy reason) in the two campaign-period months read. JODI-Oil publishes a numeric database with definitions, a manual and availability footnotes only; the pages opened carry no narrative attribution.
lanes.limitation: Only two monthly IPI release PDFs were read in full (March and April 2026, English), so no continuous span is covered and covered_through is null. The 2022-2025 monthly releases, the Arabic editions and GASTAT's petroleum-and-gas statistics were not read, and the search listing did not show a complete 2022-2025 series on the pages opened. JODI's Saudi metadata page was not reached.

lanes.source_family: OPEC Monthly Oil Market Report archive
lanes.limitation: All three official OPEC addresses tried (current page, the MOMR download host, the legacy publications page) refused automated access with HTTP 402. No issue was read and no workaround was attempted; the lane needs a person to open the PDFs in a browser.

lanes.source_family: Saudi Aramco disclosures: Tadawul announcements; aramco.com news and annual-report incident statements
lanes.finding: The Arabic editions add no event. Safety is reported only as annual counts (Tier 1 process-safety events, spill counts and volumes) with no facility, date or region.
lanes.limitation: FY2023 to FY2025 were read as the three section files that carry incident wording (risk, results, sustainability), not the whole report: the overview, governance, legal and financial-statement sections were not read. The reading was by Arabic keyword over extracted text, not page by page. The Tadawul list refused access again and neither declared query ran. 2026 interim documents were not opened, by rule.

lanes.source_family: GASTAT and JODI production releases (production effects explicitly attributed to a disruption)
lanes.finding: No release attributes a change to a disruption. The mining sub-index is explained each month only by 'the level of oil production in the Kingdom' with the monthly figure; refining and electricity movements are stated without a cause. A numeric series with no attribution yields context, never an incident: no candidate.
lanes.limitation: Only 2024 and 2025 are covered. The publisher's own listing (71 items, read in full) jumps from January 2024 back to 2020 and earlier: the 24 releases for 2022 and 2023 are not listed and were not read. The 2026 releases are outside the declared universe and were not opened.

lanes.source_family: OPEC Monthly Oil Market Report archive
lanes.limitation: The endpoint refused automated access again (HTTP 402). No issue was read and no workaround was attempted; the lane needs a person to open the monthly PDFs in a browser.

lanes.source_family: International and regional reporting (Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, S&P Global, Argus, as carried by open outlets), via search
registry: International news agencies and energy press (Reuters, Bloomberg, AP, S&P Global, Argus)
lanes.finding: No new event meets a clause. The outage queries return only neighbourhood, village or single-site cuts and the three regional outages already in the queue; opened Arabic sources add the time and root cause for two of them but still no customer or megawatt figure. No refinery fire in 2025 was returned at all.
lanes.limitation: Seven of fifteen declared queries ran, in the declared order, before the cap: all five for 2026 and the two Arabic ones for 2025. The three English queries for 2025 and all five for 2024 did not run, so 2025 was searched in Arabic only and 2024 not at all. A query set is not a census. Several Saudi news pages refused access, so most sub-threshold outage items rest on search summaries.
